Anya: Heads-up — ACME HW asked to do a joint perf/W and throughput matrix for their new A100v3 boards next month. Looking for owners for telemetry schema, kernel knob list, and a public-friendly press window. Thoughts?
Diego: I can lead the board-side kernel tuning. Need the initial throughput targets and power measurement cadence.
Kai: For telemetry, we should expose per-worker power, host-level thermal, and per-inference latency p95/p99. Suggest using our bench-agent v2 JSON schema. Will share snippet.
Anya: @Kai pls drop snippet here.
Kai: ```json
{
  "measurements": ["power_watts","p95_latency_ms","p99_latency_ms","tokens_per_sec"],
  "sample_interval_ms": 500
}
```
Olivia: Quick legal check — ACME wants to include named numbers in a joint press release. Are we ok with publishing perf/W from partner-run labs? NDA constraints?
Tom: Sales note — we want a marketplace listing timed with the announcement. Ideally 2 weeks after public announcement for landing page.
Diego: For kernel knobs, starting list: prefetch=on, fused_gemm=1, kv_cache_prefetch=2, fp16_kernel=optimized. Need to lock down exact compiler flags.
Kai: We should also record model config: model, sequence, batch, tokenization, quantization. Example: redwood-13b, seq512, batch4, q4_0.
Anya: Action items: Diego pick kernel knobs by 3/10; Kai finalize telemetry JSON and bench script by 3/8; Olivia confirm legal/PR permissions by 3/12; Tom draft marketplace cadence by 3/15. Can everyone ack?
Diego: ack
Kai: ack
Olivia: ack — pinging legal now
Tom: ack. I'll sketch the marketplace flow.
lab-bot: Scheduled perf run created: acme-a100v3-run-2026-03-22-0900
Anya: thanks — will sync with ACME on dates once Diego/Kai confirm. Keep thread for updates. :raising_hand:
